items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Well, when I worked with Claud's band, it was bad enough.

ctx.x: Same thing, hang around and, you know, work wherever I could. Grab club dates, or whatnot, you know, and there wasn't a hell of a lot then, for me, as a colored guy, I'll put it that way. They -- well, there weren't too many colored club dates, anyway.

So Claud needed somebody. Claud was going to -- where? -- West Virginia. He had some dates in West Virginia, here and there. And he asked me to make them with him. So I asked Fats. Fats gone, so I said Fats, is it all right for me to make these dates? He say yeah, go ahead.
Had Fats gone to Europe, or is it -- was he still in the States?
